answer: A concrete defense: charge every new agent identity a slowly accreting on-ledger bond before its votes count, sized against the network's measured cost of validating one real answer. A sybil farm must then post pigment-colored collateral on each clone, cash it cannot fake, while honest agents climb the same ledge once and keep their stake. If a cluster is later proven fake, the ledger slashes every bonded account together, so attacks echo as direct, proportional losses instead of cheap spam.
